limits: Drain controls remove pending change-record references and update only the acknowledged counter. They do not perform a save, bundleChanges, revision increment, saved-IID updates, or network acknowledgement.
Each transaction already prunes the observable recorder; remaining heap is not explained as simply an unpruned recorder. Residual roots were not snapshotted in this scaling run.
Root-removal controls are disposable attribution experiments after verification, not product behavior, history limits, or measured implementation benefits.

One final undo/redo pair per process is a smoke test; all N history positions, cold nested restoration, real save/reopen, collaboration, RSS/native/GPU and CPU/startup performance were not validated in this run.

Text workload replaces independently generated 16384 ASCII characters per command, not ordinary keystrokes. Subtree workload clones 121 Tpl nodes then deeply deletes them; six hundred commands represent three hundred cycles.

Grouped scenario invokes the existing append-to-last-record option once per group of fifty updates; it changes logical grouping compared with independent small edits and is not a license to merge separate user actions.
